validity_flags.finding: Observed counts, output acceptance and summary arithmetic match saved records within declared numerical tolerance.
Forty-two primary jobs are controlled instances of eight input templates in seven bounded families; review, controls, transfer and repeated load are separate denominators.
Critic and adjudicator share deterministic contract logic; independent Python implementation is not an externally blinded human assessment.
Full monetary cost, employer attention, authoring cost, deployment and maintenance remain materially unmeasured; human economics is conditional.
Policy discovery_cpu_seconds covers the eight paired search evaluations per cycle, excluding useful parent delivery and later presentation calls; do not label it a complete cycle cost.

Retained planning repair lost all twelve fresh specialist quality comparisons; source incremental CPU point ratio exceeds one with an interval crossing one. No positive incremental productivity claim is supported.

Control cases demonstrate bounded local refusal, cooperative STOP, injected interruption/fresh restart and local selection rollback, not an authenticated remote executor, continuous operation or transactional recovery.
Wilson and paired bootstrap intervals describe this bounded purposive sample; repeated scale calls are not independent task diversity.

scope: Read-only reacceptance and arithmetic audit; no new execution outcomes and no frozen source changes
